text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono didn't get first place...
But wow...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's huge! And the force and speed
she ran
with was terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again! I got some
awesome
shots! Now I feel bad for joking
about wanting to
get funny pics of her...

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Bono is usually so easygoing, but that
intensity
and focus she has on the
racetrack is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text:
For sure.
I think I'll go see her next race
too! I
might be hooked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I was sooo close!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm disappointed, but... I'm glad I got to
run hard
with everybody.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And the fans seemed to have had a
good time
too, with all their cheering
and applause...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think I can do better in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, what should I run next,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I hope the next race will make me even
fuller than
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's proven that her body is
strong
enough for her to hold her own,
even in G1
sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which means winning a G1 mile race
should be
our next goal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! That one's a big race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bet there will be even stronger racers
there!
Maybe I can run against Biko
again too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Yes, I definitely want to run in
that one!
Let's do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, going directly from a sprint to
a G1
mile race has me a bit worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be safe, I'd like to have her run in a
bigger
race first. Something around
1,400 meters would
be good.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good to me! Swans, huh?
They're
such nice and big birds.
choice_data_list: How about we slot in the Swan Stak...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a bit of discussion,
our next goal is
set. Now
that we're ready to get the ball
rolling...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Biko? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You were really impressive, Bono.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though you didn't place first,
everyone was so shocked by your
running, and their eyes were glittering
as
they watched you...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yet, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I can't get all sad now! A
crestfallen hero is
no hero at all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stand up, Biko Pegasus! Never give in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Biko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell anyone what you just saw,
okay,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, a bright and powerful racer
from the
United States lurks nearby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing alone next to the nearly empty
stands
and trembling violently is Taiki
Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is so excitin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful gal that Hishi
Akebono is! She's
big and strong—and
absolutely thrillin' to watch!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I... I wanna run in a big race with her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of emotions are running high as
the
Sprinters S. comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Swan S. Now's the time to
ramp up our training so Hishi Akebono
can really spread her
wings and take
flight!
